newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ First's Peters says Alliance has no option.
newsitem.headline: NZ First's Peters says Alliance has no option.

text.p: New Zealand First Party leader Winston Peters said on Thursday he believed the left-wing Alliance Party would have no option but to support New Zealand First and the Labour Party, should they form a coalition government.

"If that was the choice, that New Zealand First would go with Labour, then there would be no option for the Alliance given their support base, and given the statements they have made in the past," Peters told a news conference.
Peters reiterated comments that Labour would have to negotiate support from the Alliance before NZ First would agree to form a coalition with Labour.
"We have made it clear that where Labour is concerned, we would leave it to Labour to make that contact."

Peters said he expected informal talks between Labour and the caretaker National government to continue into the early part of next week but formal talks would also take place at an unspecified time next week.
